# Time of day / weekday (`time`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Context · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

True during a time window and/or on certain weekdays. Windows that cross midnight (after 22:00, before 06:00) are supported.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `after` | time of day (`HH:mm`) | no |  | Start of the window (inclusive), 24-hour clock. |
| `before` | time of day (`HH:mm`) | no |  | End of the window (exclusive), 24-hour clock. |
| `weekdays` | list of: `mon`, `tue`, `wed`, `thu`, `fri`, `sat`, `sun` | no |  | Only on these days. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: time
    after: "09:00"
    before: "17:30"
    weekdays: [mon, tue, wed, thu, fri]
```

## Notes

Quote times in YAML ("22:00") so they are not read as numbers.
